name: Tresemme Heat Defence Care & Protect Spray 300ml For All Hair Types
description:
Product details of Tresemme Heat Defence Care & Protect Spray – 300ml (For All Hair Types)

Product Type: Heat Protection Spray

Size: 300ml

Suitable For: All hair types

Country of Origin: UK

Key Features:

Provides heat protection up to 230°C from styling tools

Infused with UV filter for added protection

Helps prevent damage from hair dryers, straighteners & curlers

Smoothes frizz while sealing in shine

Lightweight formula, leaves hair looking healthy and glossy

Professional quality trusted by salon experts
